attributes.board_name: Nebraska Board of Dentistry (DHHS Licensure Unit)

rules.carryover: Not allowed: hours above 30 in a 24-month renewal period do not carry over.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Acceptable continuing education per 172 NAC 57-006; max 10 h home study or initial CPR, max 4 h CPR re-certification or practice management, max 5 h each for clinic faculty, dental public health, well-being/substance abuse or ethics, max 5 h volunteer activity (e.g. Mission of Mercy).
rules.audit_note: Licensee keeps certificates or records of continuing education; DHHS may audit. Waiver possible for circumstances beyond the licensee's control lasting over 30 consecutive days.

topics.who: All dental hygienists (minimum 2 hours per renewal period)

rules.notes: At least 30 hours in the 24 months before March 1 of each odd-numbered year (172 NAC 57-006). Holders of an expanded function permit need at least 2 hours in each permitted area per renewal period.
rules.rule_quote: You must have earned 30 hours of continuing competency within the previous two-year period immediately preceding the date of this application.
